(1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Zavijava is HR 4540., cross-checked against Kiehling (1987), spectrophotometry of 60 bright F, G, K and M stars, 320-880 nm in 1 nm steps as normalised magnitudes: Kiehling (1987), A&AS 69, 465; VizieR III/124. * bet Vir is HR 4540. entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,132 K and log g 4.11 (u1 0.393, u2 0.297): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
